sections.Profile:
Zip-A-Doo is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Bally Manufacturing Co. in August 1970. Designed by Ted Zale, with artwork by Christian Marche, this machine has a fun park theme and features two flippers, a mechanical reel display, and a two-player setup.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1970
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Good Times, Flowers, Dancing, Original Theme, 1970s
